readme: # InstallerRestrictor Simple ExPosed module to restrict any installation / uninstallation process across the system. Tested with LSPosed. ### How to use - Install module - Enable module in LSPosed - Scope to recommended scope (system_server) - Reboot device ### Uninstallation - Turn module off - Reboot - Uninstall [Original repository](https://github.com/redacted-text/InstallerRestrictor)
